strategy.summary: Collect double-lit numbers, then move the Golden Arrow to the safest repeatable shot.

steps.text: Find the number that has the Golden Arrow.
Shoot an uncollected lit number for 5,000. If it also has the Golden Arrow, it scores 10,000.
Use a spinner or the center star rollover to move the Golden Arrow when its shot is unsafe.
After a number is collected, it stays off. The Golden Arrow does not move when you collect its shot.
When the Golden Arrow reaches a safe shot, repeat that shot for 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Lit numbers
quickInfo.summary: An uncollected lit number scores 5,000, or 10,000 when the Golden Arrow is on the same number.

quickInfo.name: Golden Arrow
quickInfo.summary: The two spinners and center star move the Arrow, while collecting its number leaves the Arrow in place.

quickInfo.name: Collected numbers
quickInfo.summary: A collected number stays off, so read the remaining lamps before choosing a target or lane.

quickInfo.name: Post-completion route
quickInfo.summary: After all ten numbers, move the Arrow to the safest repeatable 5,000-point shot.

fallback.title: Use the top and bumpers
fallback.when: Use this plan when the Golden Arrow is on a dangerous direct shot.

steps.text: Send the ball toward the top without aiming at a dangerous standup.
Recheck the Golden Arrow after a spinner or center-star advance.
Collect each lit 1-10 number. A collected number stays off.
Use the Golden Arrow position to collect a needed number for 10,000 when its shot is safe.
After all 10 numbers are complete, move the Golden Arrow to the safest repeatable 5,000-point shot.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Watch the first spinner or standup rebound. Nudge while the ball still has space to move away from the center drain or outlane.

cautions.issue: Either spinner can feed a center drain.
cautions.response: Use a spinner only when moving the Golden Arrow is worth the risk. Watch the first feed and nudge when needed.

cautions.issue: The 5, 6, 9, and 10 lanes can feed a sling or an outlane.
cautions.response: Shoot only the lit lane you need. Watch its return before you repeat it.

cautions.issue: The 1, 4, 7, and 8 standups and their side posts can send the ball out of control.
cautions.response: Do not shoot an unlit standup. Nudge after the rebound when needed.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Golden Arrow, each uncollected lit number scores 5,000, and the moving Golden Arrow doubles its current number to 10,000. Use a spinner or the center star rollover to move the Arrow when its shot is unsafe. After all ten numbers are collected, park the Arrow on the safest repeatable shot and keep shooting it for 5,000.
strategy.overview: In Golden Arrow, the ten numbered shots remain available until collected, while the moving Golden Arrow doubles its current lit number to 10,000. Collect safe double-lit numbers, move the Arrow with a spinner or the center star rollover when necessary, and finish all ten numbers. Then move the Arrow to the safest repeatable shot and keep collecting 5,000 there.
